definitions.gloss: water injection; pouring water; filling with water
definitions.explanation: The act of pouring or injecting water into something. Used in industrial, agricultural, culinary, and emergency contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦タンク→タンク：23095_tanku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注水|ちゅうすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{注水|ちゅうすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Water filling of the rice paddies has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原子炉|げんしろ}→原子炉：20824_genshiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{冷却|れいきゃく}→冷却：09796_reikyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{注水|ちゅうすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Emergency water injection was carried out to cool the reactor.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{注|ちゅう}→注：03434_chuu⟧ (pour, inject) and {水|すい} (water). This word became widely known in Japan during the 2011 Fukushima nuclear disaster, when {注水|ちゅうすい} operations to cool the damaged reactors were a constant topic in news coverage.

Beyond nuclear emergencies, {注水|ちゅうすい} is used in agriculture (flooding rice paddies), industry (filling tanks and systems), and cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注水|ちゅうすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to inject/pour water
- {注水|ちゅうすい}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: water injection work
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{注水|ちゅうすい}: emergency water injection
- {注水|ちゅうすい}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: amount of water injected
- {注水|ちゅうすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開始|かいし}する→開始する：26826_kaishisuru⟧: to begin water injection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{加水|かすい}→加水：24921_kasui⟧: adding water — focuses on mixing water into a substance (e.g., dough, a solution)
- ⟦{給水|きゅうすい}→給水：15031_kyuusui⟧: water supply — providing water to people, buildings, or systems
- ⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧: drainage — the opposite process: removing water
